name: Kayla Brooks

five_sec.what_is_it: dinner planner that texts ur family and dumps the list in instacart or walmart
five_sec.who_for: moms w kids who can text
five_sec.trust_why: no card + it doesn't say AI anywhere up top, which ngl is rare. but 'Powered by Instacart' badge feels kinda like an ad
five_sec.next_step: scroll for gluten-free and see if it's AI
five_sec.delivers_food_why: 'We don't deliver food. We plan your week and send your grocery list.' pretty hard to miss

full_page.what_stopped_me: gluten-free is a little chip on the sample week and a footer link. it never says celiac. 'dietary needs respected' doesn't tell me if the walmart match is gonna grab regular soy sauce. also 'Instacart pays us a small commission' so yeah it's kinda an ad lol. at least they said it
full_page.whats_missing: the word celiac. how the cart picks gf products. whether i can be gf and tyler's son gets regular pasta (per-person stuff is only on the paid plan)

DD.quote: free, walmart, an actual founder named sarah, and 'always check ingredient labels' on the pricing page. ok that last one is lowkey the most trustworthy line here

five_sec.who_for: ppl who trust AI with their food. not me
five_sec.trust_why: the page title is literally 'AI Meal Planning for Families.' instant ick for a celiac
five_sec.delivers_food_why: it's an app menu not a box

full_page.what_stopped_me: 'Ollie's state-of-the-art intelligence... write a recipe just for you.' an AI writing my recipes is how i get glutened. also $25/mo on the pricing page?? for dinner ideas??
full_page.whats_missing: a single word about gluten-free or allergies. a human checking anything

OL.quote: 'state-of-the-art intelligence' writing my recipes. it's giving glutened by a chatbot

five_sec.who_for: ppl who save a million recipes. ok kinda me
five_sec.trust_why: real app ratings and no card. countdown sale at the bottom is a lil much
five_sec.next_step: see if it saves from tiktok

full_page.what_stopped_me: it saves recipes from TikTok and instagram, which means i could save my celiac creators' stuff and know it's safe. but no free plan after 14 days, $5.95/mo. they even have a FAQ 'why isn't there a free plan' lol
full_page.whats_missing: a free tier. any planning for me. walmart named for the grocery thing

PTE.quote: saving my gf tiktok creators' recipes is actually smart. but $5.95 after two weeks and i'm still doing all the planning

five_sec.what_is_it: hellofresh boxes + a mystery box popup
five_sec.trust_why: 'Open A Box To Reveal Your Offer' is a scratch-off ticket
five_sec.delivers_food_why: the boxes, the food photos. it's a meal kit

full_page.what_stopped_me: boxes packed in a facility with wheat, reddit already told me. menu is ciabatta, panko, pita, ramen. auto-renewing fine print
full_page.whats_missing: anything gf. a price without my zip

HF.quote: panko, ciabatta, pita, ramen. and a mystery box game. no thx

five_sec.what_is_it: meal plan thing with a video
five_sec.trust_why: looks legit but tells u nothing on screen one
five_sec.delivers_food_why: phone w food icons around it, could be an ordering app

full_page.what_stopped_me: there IS a gluten free plan, 'for those with a gluten allergy or sensitivity,' and dietitians. but it's a 14 day trial with no price and an email popup 'LIMITED TIME.' that's an auto-renew waiting to happen
full_page.whats_missing: the price. whether gf means celiac-safe or just 'we left out the bread'

EM.quote: a real gluten free plan, ok. but no price and a 'limited time' popup. i know how trials work

dd_offer.why: says no card like 5 times and 'you go back to the free plan.' they even email 3 days before
dd_offer.expect_day_15: the texting stuff turns off and it's just the free planner. they don't have my card so nothing gets charged

head_to_head.reason: only one that's actually free, does walmart, isn't screaming AI, and has a real person behind it

OL.reason: ollie is AI writing recipes. hard no for celiac

PTE.reason: plan to eat is safer recipes-wise but costs money and doesn't plan anything

HF.reason: boxes from a wheat facility vs a list i shop myself. easy

EM.reason: emeals has a gf plan but it's a paid trial w hidden price. DD is free

dd_fix_that_would_move_me: pricing page (/start) diet FAQ + the home page sample week: say celiac by name, and say how the walmart/instacart match handles gluten-free (like flagging soy sauce, broth, oats to double-check) instead of just 'gluten-free' as a chip. move the 'always check ingredient labels' line up next to it
